Why Duzan

A neighborhood kitchen,
done properly

01

Palestinian recipes, Steinway soul

Duzan's kitchen draws on Palestinian home cooking — the hummus styles alone run from classic to Abu Ghosh, Yafa, Jerusalem and Msabaha.

02

Portions that don't skimp

It's the thing every review mentions: generous bowls and platters at prices that won't break the bank. Come hungry, leave with leftovers.

03

Fast counter, made fresh

Shawarma carved to order, falafel fried when you ask, pita baked fresh. Counter service keeps it quick — most pickups are ready in minutes.
